entities.summary: Bezdin Monastery is a monastery of the Serbian community, located near the village of Munar in Arad County, Romania, on the right bank of the Mureș River. Bezdin Monastery is one of the few remaining Serbian Orthodox monasteries in Romania, located 36 km (22 mi) west of Arad. The monastery was constructed in 1539 and is dedicated to the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin, celebrated on August 28 according to the New Style.
